CustomField.description: Specify the field types for an InputTable in comma delimited format. Example: text,picklist:opt1;opt2,checkbox For file attachments add the field type fileupload in the last position. For example: text,picklist:opt1;opt2,checkbox,fileupload
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Specify the field types for an InputTable in comma delimited format. Example: text,picklist:opt1;opt2,checkbox For file attachments add the field type fileupload in the last position. For example: text,picklist:opt1;opt2,checkbox,fileupload. 1 / row only
CustomField.label: Field Types for Input Table
